mechanism_narrative: High levels of GDP indicate strong economic demand, which positively impacts S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when GDPC1 is high.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates signal a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP and low federal funds rate indicate strong demand and easy monetary policy, enhancing S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when GDPC1 is high and FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth during expansion signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when INDPRO grows during expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, positively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher with increasing PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts growth indicates strong demand in the housing market, positively affecting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when HOUST grows over 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and high unemployment indicate conflicting monetary and labor signals, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur with low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Real state and local government finance growth indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns during expansion.
failure_condition: No positive returns when RSAFS grows during expansion.
